info.name: TrustGate API v1
info.description: Postman collection for testing all TrustGate API endpoints. Session-based auth (cookie). Run 'Setup → Login as Owner' first to get session cookie.

variable.description: Base URL of the TrustGate API server
Auto-filled after login. Laravel session cookie value.

request.description:
RUN THIS LOCALLY IN TERMINAL:

```bash
# Create a test PDF (10MB max)
echo 'Test document content for TrustGate' | base64 > /tmp/test-content.txt
# Or use any PDF file:
cp /path/to/your/document.pdf /tmp/test-document.pdf

# For encrypted test, you'd encrypt client-side first (WebCrypto AES-GCM)
# This collection uses placeholder values - replace with real encrypted data
```

Then set TEST_FILE_PATH in environment to your file path.

Laravel session-based login. Cookie (laravel_session) is auto-saved to LARAVEL_SESSION variable.

After login, subsequent requests will use the session cookie automatically via pre-request script.

exec: // Extract laravel_session cookie from response headers
// Also try to get from response cookies (Postman cookie jar)
